methodology.validation: Repeated walk-forward with expanding windows; in each fold, training, calibration and test are contiguous, later and non-overlapping blocks.
methodology.calibration: Isotonic when the calibration window has 30+ cases of each class, Platt scaling otherwise.
methodology.no_leakage: Macro variables shifted one month; no random splits; market targets built on each asset's own trading sessions.
methodology.revisions: Reference periods validated; the missing historical vintage is stated and mitigated with a conservative lag.
methodology.idempotency: Snapshots use a stable identity of coverage, observations and probabilities.
methodology.metrics: Brier, log loss, AUC, accuracy and calibration curve, all out of sample.
methodology.comparisons: Official NBER recessions with a declared window; BTC cycles split at halving blocks.
